name: liquidcad
description: Workspace scripts. The desktop app lives in apps/desktop, the engine in crates/.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/desktop install && cargo build -p liquidcad-cli
scripts.milestone: cargo run -p liquidcad-cli -- eval projects/modular-dock/liquidcad.json artifacts/milestone
scripts.desktop: cargo build -p liquidcad-cli && npm --prefix apps/desktop run dev
scripts.start: cargo build -p liquidcad-cli && npm --prefix apps/desktop run build && npm --prefix apps/desktop start
scripts.test:e2e: cargo build -p liquidcad-cli && npm --prefix apps/desktop run test:e2e
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm --prefix apps/desktop run typecheck
scripts.package: cargo build --release -p liquidcad-cli && node scripts/stage-engine.mjs && npm --prefix apps/desktop run package
scripts.demo: cargo build -p liquidcad-cli && npm --prefix apps/desktop run demo && node scripts/encode-demos.mjs
